scope: all 12 elaborated-reachability transitions among the six selected source-grounded theorem declarations

delta_vector_definition.delta_local: descendant bounded local support minus ancestor support
delta_vector_definition.delta_frontier: descendant external frontier minus ancestor frontier
delta_vector_definition.delta_direct: new direct local references on descendant relative to ancestor
delta_vector_definition.delta_depth: descendant support maximum local depth minus ancestor support maximum local depth

interpretation_boundary: Categories describe observed support changes; they do not label transitions intrinsically hard or optimal. Downstream reuse is measured only within the selected six-node graph.

falsifier.question: Does every transition have a small marginal delta or does the selected graph contain world-expanding edges?

domination.method: iterative node dominators with super-root; edge dominance by edge-removal reachability

frontier_reuse_scope: Exact per-declaration counts are identity-level measurements within the selected six-node graph; no savings or causal effect is inferred.
